original_sign_offline.limit: Old report did not save native per-capture settled pose and style. Diagnostic responses do not supersede original absolute_delta and layout failures.

final_r7_sign_offline.conclusion: The fixed broad ROI captures changed background. The brown-row panel detector includes terrain beyond the actual right board edge, so masking only to reported panel bounds would retain all 109 contaminating pixels. Within the manually inspected actual board, glyph-plus-outline coverage matches, but that post-hoc diagnostic is not acceptance. Projection blank wood also has 163 pixels over the original delta cutoff, so baseline stability remains unresolved.

MCDEV_NATIVE_CAPTURE_EXE was supplied without MCDEV_NATIVE_CAPTURE_HELPER; frozen SignCheck selected legacy PrintWindow and rejected a white frame. This was not a WGC failure.
